name: bunq-banking-mcp
description: bunq banking MCP and evidence-based subscription and finance workflows.

interface.longDescription: Read bunq accounts and reconcile bank transactions, billing emails, subscriptions, fees and refunds with explicit source coverage. Includes controlled nonfinancial operations. Requires uv, a local Python 3.11 environment and a 1Password-backed bunq API context.
defaultPrompt: Audit my subscriptions using bank records and billing emails.
Reconcile my spending, income, transfers and refunds.
Show my bunq accounts and balances.

prompts: Audit my subscriptions using bank records and billing emails.

publication.release_notes: Improved uniquely reciprocal empty-description and explicit FX transfer matching with matching basis and confidence. Added deeper audit guidance for missing history, investment movements, provider retry receipts and acquisition-cost ROI. Fixed exact-decimal precision and pagination input guards, corrected local-tool annotations, and isolated the Python 3.11 launcher with uv.
